coordinate_map.field: K algebraically closed, characteristic 0; exact coefficient arithmetic below is over Q
coordinate_map.map: phi_sigma: K[x,y] -> K[pi]<<t>>, x |-> t^-1, y |-> sum_{j<rho} a_j*t^j+pi*t^rho
coordinate_map.source: Xu arXiv:1604.07683v4, pp.1-2 and equation (7.1) on printed/PDF p.12
coordinate_map.warning: rho is the split order; roster source.delta is a different array; theta is the split-screen auxiliary and is not Xu's t
